summary: Automatically synchronize installed ZBRANO releases to Workshop Memory.
features: Automatically record each newly installed ZBRANO version in Workshop Memory.
Provide a standing-authorization toggle and manual retry control in Settings.
Show synchronization state through the release-sync API and Developer diagnostics.
fixes: Prevent duplicate release entries with a stable version marker.
Retry synchronization without delaying or blocking application startup.
Preserve the complete existing release note through Workshop Memory backup-backed replacement.
